title: Republic Bank Appoints Frank Vitarelli as Florida Market President
summary: Experienced Banking Leader to Fuel Republic Bank’s Continued Momentum in Florida Republic Bank Trust Company (“Republic” or the “Bank”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Frank Vitarelli as Florida Market President. Frank Vitarelli Vitarelli is a seasoned financial services leader with more than 25 years of experience driving growth, strengthening client relationships, and leading high‑performing teams throughout the Tampa Bay region.
